ja: 歌をはじめよう。なぞれば、歌になる。
zh-CN: 开始一首歌。走完它，歌就唱成了。
ko: 노래를 시작해요. 따라 걸으면 노래가 불려요.

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title.

en: Send a helpful robot to do swaps where it can.
pt-BR: Envie um robô prestativo para fazer trocas onde puder.
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines).
fr: Envoie un robot serviable faire des échanges là où il peut.
de: Schickt einen hilfsbereiten Roboter, der tauscht, wo er kann.
pl: Wyślij pomocnego robota, by robił zamiany, gdzie się da.
es: Envía un robot servicial a hacer cambios donde pueda.
ru: Пошли робота-помощника делать обмены, где он может.
tr: Yapabildiği yerde takas yapan yardımsever bir robot gönder.
ja: 親切なロボットが、できるところで入れ替えてくれる。
zh-CN: 派一个热心的机器人去做能做的交换。
ko: 친절한 로봇을 보내 할 수 있는 곳에서 자리를 바꿔요.

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title.

en: a swap. if it pops fish, the new fish that drop in are all the kind that was moved
pt-BR: uma troca. se estourar peixes, os novos que caem são todos do tipo que foi movido
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines).
fr: un échange. s'il fait éclater des poissons, les nouveaux qui tombent sont tous de l'espèce déplacée
de: ein Tausch. lässt er Fische platzen, sind alle neu fallenden Fische von der bewegten Sorte
pl: zamiana. jeśli coś zbije, wszystkie nowe spadające ryby będą tego gatunku, który przesunięto
es: un cambio. si explota peces, los nuevos que caen son todos del tipo que moviste
ru: обмен. если рыбы лопнут, все новые рыбы будут того же вида, что и сдвинутая
tr: bir takas. balık patlatırsa, düşen yeni balıkların hepsi taşınan türden olur
ja: 入れ替え1回。魚がはじけたら、落ちてくる魚はすべて動かした魚と同じ種類
zh-CN: 一次交换。如果消除了鱼，落进来的新鱼都是被移动的那种
ko: 바꾸기 한 번. 물고기가 터지면 새로 떨어지는 물고기가 전부 옮긴 종류예요

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title.

en: pops every belly up fish and every skeleton at once, for {$times} times the points
pt-BR: estoura todos os peixes de barriga para cima e todos os esqueletos de uma vez, por {$times} vezes os pontos
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines).
fr: fait éclater d'un coup tous les poissons ventre en l'air et tous les squelettes, pour {$times} fois les points
de: lässt alle Fische mit Bauch nach oben und alle Skelette auf einmal platzen, für das {$times}-Fache der Punkte
pl: zbija naraz każdą rybę brzuchem do góry i każdy szkielet, za {$times} razy więcej punktów
es: explota a la vez cada pez panza arriba y cada esqueleto, por {$times} veces los puntos
ru: лопает разом всех рыб кверху брюхом и все скелеты, очки x{$times}
tr: karnı üstü her balığı ve her iskeleti bir anda {$times} kat puanla patlatır
ja: ひっくり返った魚とガイコツをまとめてはじく。得点は{$times}倍
zh-CN: 一次消除所有翻肚的鱼和鱼骨，得分{$times}倍
ko: 배 뒤집힌 물고기와 뼈다귀를 한꺼번에 터뜨려요. 점수는 {$times}배

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title.

en: a swap that stacks the fish it connects into one, instead of popping them
pt-BR: uma troca que empilha os peixes que conecta em um só, em vez de estourá-los
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines).
fr: un échange qui empile en un seul les poissons qu'il relie, au lieu de les faire éclater
de: ein Tausch, der die verbundenen Fische zu einem stapelt, statt sie platzen zu lassen
pl: zamiana, która łączy połączone ryby w jeden stos, zamiast je zbijać
es: un cambio que apila en uno los peces que une, en vez de explotarlos
ru: обмен, который складывает связанных рыб в одну стопку, а не лопает их
tr: bağladığı balıkları patlatmak yerine tek balıkta yığan bir takas
ja: つながった魚をはじかずに1匹に重ねる入れ替え
zh-CN: 一次交换，把连起来的鱼叠成一条，而不是消除它们
ko: 이어진 물고기를 터뜨리지 않고 하나로 쌓는 바꾸기

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title.

en: Hold, and walk two sides of a box. Let go, and the fish around its edge go one along
pt-BR: Segure, e percorra dois lados de uma caixa. Solte, e os peixes da borda andam uma casa
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines).
fr: Maintiens, et parcours deux côtés d'un carré. Lâche, et les poissons du bord avancent d'une case
de: Halten, und zwei Seiten eines Kastens abgehen. Loslassen, und die Fische am Rand rücken eins weiter
pl: Przytrzymaj i przejdź dwa boki kwadratu. Puść, a ryby na jego brzegu przesuną się o jedno pole
es: Mantén y recorre dos lados de un cuadro. Suelta, y los peces de su borde avanzan uno
ru: Зажми и пройди две стороны рамки. Отпусти, и рыбы по краю сдвинутся на одну
tr: Basılı tut, bir kutunun iki kenarını yürü. Bırakınca kenardaki balıklar bir adım döner
ja: 押したまま四角の2辺をなぞる。はなすと、ふちの魚が1つずつずれる
zh-CN: 按住，沿方框走两条边。松开后，边上的鱼会各挪一格
ko: 누른 채 상자의 두 변을 걸어요. 놓으면 가장자리 물고기가 한 칸씩 돌아요

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title.

en: Upgrade selection shows every available card.
pt-BR: A escolha de melhorias mostra todas as cartas disponíveis.
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines).
fr: Le choix d'améliorations montre toutes les cartes disponibles.
de: Die Upgrade-Auswahl zeigt alle verfügbaren Karten.
pl: Wybór ulepszeń pokazuje wszystkie dostępne karty.
es: La elección de mejoras muestra todas las cartas disponibles.
ru: При выборе улучшения видны все доступные карты.
tr: Yükseltme seçimi mevcut tüm kartları gösterir.
ja: 強化の選択で、選べるカードがすべて見える。
zh-CN: 升级时显示所有可选的卡。
ko: 업그레이드 고를 때 나올 수 있는 카드가 전부 보여요.

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title.

en: Take only memories. No more upgrades at round breaks. Multiplier will never go down.
pt-BR: Leve só lembranças. Sem melhorias entre rodadas. O multiplicador nunca vai cair.
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines). "Take only memories" echoes the hiker's motto "take only pictures, leave only footprints".
fr: Ne prends que des souvenirs. Plus d'améliorations entre les manches. Le multiplicateur ne baissera jamais.
de: Nimm nur Erinnerungen mit. Keine Upgrades mehr in Rundenpausen. Der Multiplikator sinkt nie.
pl: Zabierz tylko wspomnienia. Koniec ulepszeń między rundami. Mnożnik nigdy nie spadnie.
es: Llévate solo recuerdos. No más mejoras entre rondas. El multiplicador nunca bajará.
ru: Бери только воспоминания. Больше никаких улучшений между раундами. Множитель никогда не падает.
tr: Yalnızca anı al. Tur aralarında artık yükseltme yok. Çarpan hiç düşmez.
ja: 持ち帰るのは思い出だけ。ラウンドの合間の強化はなし。倍率は決して下がらない。
zh-CN: 只带走回忆。回合间不再升级。倍率永远不会下降。
ko: 추억만 가져가요. 라운드 사이 업그레이드는 이제 없어요. 배수는 절대 내려가지 않아요.

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title. The card summons an anglerfish, whose lure is a light.

en: An old angler fish answers a question. Or keep its light, and ask in info mode.
pt-BR: Um velho peixe-pescador responde a uma pergunta. Ou guarde sua luz, e pergunte no modo info.
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines).
fr: Une vieille baudroie répond à une question. Ou garde sa lumière, et demande en mode info.
de: Ein alter Anglerfisch beantwortet eine Frage. Oder behalte sein Licht und frag im Info-Modus.
pl: Stary wędkarz głębin odpowie na pytanie. Albo zachowaj jego światło i zapytaj w trybie info.
es: Un viejo pez linterna responde una pregunta. O guarda su luz y pregunta en el modo info.
ru: Старая удильщица ответит на вопрос. Или оставь её свет и спроси в режиме инфо.
tr: Yaşlı bir fener balığı bir soruyu yanıtlar. Ya da ışığını sakla, bilgi modunda sor.
ja: 年老いたアンコウが質問に1つ答える。または明かりを持っておき、インフォモードでたずねよう。
zh-CN: 一条老安康鱼回答一个问题。或者留着它的灯，在信息模式里问。
ko: 늙은 초롱아귀가 질문 하나에 답해 줘요. 아니면 불빛을 챙겨 두고 정보 모드에서 물어봐요.

notes: The title of the upgrade screen.
Info mode: the list of passive upgrades at the side of the board. Short (112 pixels).

en: Upgrades that are always switched on are listed here.
pt-BR: As melhorias que ficam sempre ligadas aparecem aqui.
notes: Info mode.
fr: Les améliorations toujours actives sont listées ici.
de: Upgrades, die immer aktiv sind, stehen hier.
pl: Tu są ulepszenia, które działają cały czas.
es: Aquí aparecen las mejoras que están siempre activas.
tr: Hep açık olan yükseltmeler burada listelenir.
ja: いつも効いている強化はここに並ぶ。
zh-CN: 一直生效的升级列在这里。
ko: 늘 켜져 있는 업그레이드가 여기 나와요.

notes: Info mode: the list of special moves at the side of the board. Short (140 pixels).

en: Upgrades that give you a new kind of move are listed here.
pt-BR: As melhorias que dão um novo tipo de jogada aparecem aqui.
notes: Info mode.
fr: Les améliorations qui donnent un nouveau type de coup sont listées ici.
de: Upgrades, die dir eine neue Art Zug geben, stehen hier.
pl: Tu są ulepszenia, które dają ci nowy rodzaj ruchu.
es: Aquí aparecen las mejoras que te dan un nuevo tipo de jugada.
ru: Здесь улучшения, которые дают новый вид хода.
tr: Sana yeni bir hamle türü veren yükseltmeler burada listelenir.
ja: 新しい動きができる強化はここに並ぶ。
zh-CN: 给你新招式的升级列在这里。
ko: 새로운 종류의 이동을 주는 업그레이드가 여기 나와요.

notes: The kind of a card, under its name. {passive} is an icon.
The kind of a card, under its name. {move} is an icon. A special move the player uses with a button.
The kind of a card, under its name. {instant} is an icon. It acts once, when taken.
A line under the cards. Short: three lines share the bottom of the screen.
A line under the cards: deal new cards, at a price in moves. Short. The number is always 5 or more.
A line under the cards, with the "open book" card: shows every card.
A Steam timeline range and its tooltip, for the upgrade screen.
A Steam timeline range description.
The words follow button icons.
A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title. Fish that fall into place together, facing one way, form a school.

en: Fish that fall together, facing one way, school too. Not only the ones you swap.
pt-BR: Peixes que caem juntos, virados para o mesmo lado, também formam cardume. Não só os que você troca.
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines). A school is a group of fish that all face the same way.
fr: Les poissons qui tombent ensemble, tournés du même côté, forment aussi un banc. Pas seulement ceux que tu échanges.
de: Fische, die zusammen fallen und in eine Richtung schauen, bilden auch einen Schwarm. Nicht nur die, die du tauschst.
pl: Ryby, które spadną razem, zwrócone w jedną stronę, też tworzą ławicę. Nie tylko te, które zamienisz.
es: Los peces que caen juntos, mirando a un lado, también forman banco. No solo los que cambias.
ru: Рыбы, что падают вместе и смотрят в одну сторону, тоже сбиваются в косяк. Не только те, что ты меняешь.
tr: Birlikte düşüp aynı yöne bakan balıklar da sürü olur. Yalnızca takas ettiklerin değil.
ja: 同じ向きでいっしょに落ちた魚も群れになる。入れ替えた魚だけじゃない。
zh-CN: 一起落下、朝同一方向的鱼也会结群。不只是你交换的那些。
ko: 같은 쪽을 보며 함께 떨어진 물고기도 떼를 지어요. 바꾼 물고기만이 아니에요.

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title. A move: a swap after which both fish turn to face the other way.

en: A swap that turns both fish around.
pt-BR: Uma troca que vira os dois peixes para o outro lado.
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines). Fish face left or right; this swap leaves both facing the opposite way.
fr: Un échange qui fait faire demi-tour aux deux poissons.
de: Ein Tausch, nach dem sich beide Fische umdrehen.
pl: Zamiana, po której obie ryby się odwracają.
es: Un cambio que da la vuelta a los dos peces.
tr: İki balığı da ters çeviren bir takas.
ja: 2匹とも向きが変わる入れ替え。
zh-CN: 一次交换，让两条鱼都掉头。

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title. A move: a swap whose points are doubled.

en: A swap worth double: its points, the fish that fall after it, and any school it pops.
pt-BR: Uma troca que vale o dobro: seus pontos, os peixes que caem depois e qualquer cardume que ela estourar.
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines). A school is a group of fish facing one way, which swims off into the background and can pop later for points.
fr: Un échange qui vaut double : ses points, les poissons qui tombent ensuite, et les bancs qu'il fait éclater.
de: Ein Tausch, der doppelt zählt: seine Punkte, die Fische, die danach fallen, und jeder Schwarm, den er platzen lässt.
pl: Zamiana warta podwójnie: jej punkty, ryby, które spadną po niej, i każda ławica, którą rozbije.
es: Un cambio que vale el doble: sus puntos, los peces que caen tras él y cualquier banco que explote.
ru: Обмен вдвойне: его очки, рыбы, что падают после, и любой косяк, что он лопнет.
tr: Çift değerli bir takas: puanları, ardından düşen balıklar ve patlattığı her sürü.
ja: 得点2倍の入れ替え。その得点も、あとに落ちる魚も、はじけた群れも。
zh-CN: 一次双倍的交换：它的得分、之后落下的鱼，以及它消除的鱼群。
ko: 두 배짜리 바꾸기: 그 점수, 뒤이어 떨어지는 물고기, 터뜨리는 물고기 떼까지.

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title. A passive: a school that is sent away by a mistake keeps some of its fish.

en: When a school swims away, a third of it stays behind.
pt-BR: Quando um cardume vai embora, um terço dele fica.
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines). A school swims away when the player steps off one of its kind without a match; with this card, two thirds go and one third stays.
fr: Quand un banc s'en va, un tiers reste.
de: Wenn ein Schwarm wegschwimmt, bleibt ein Drittel da.
pl: Gdy ławica odpływa, jedna trzecia zostaje.
es: Cuando un banco se va nadando, un tercio se queda.
ru: Когда косяк уплывает, треть его остаётся.
tr: Bir sürü yüzüp gidince üçte biri geride kalır.
ja: 群れが泳ぎ去るとき、3分の1が残る。
zh-CN: 鱼群游走时，三分之一会留下来。
ko: 물고기 떼가 헤엄쳐 떠날 때 3분의 1은 남아요.

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title. The card makes starfish rarer on the board; "starless" is a pun on the starfish (the sea creature), so a word for having no stars works best.

pt-BR: menos % de chance de surgirem estrelas-do-mar
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines). Starfish are one of the creatures on the board.
fr: moins de % de chances que des étoiles de mer apparaissent
pl: mniej % szans, że pojawią się rozgwiazdy
es: menos % de que salgan estrellas de mar
ru: ниже % шанс, что появятся морские звёзды
ja: ヒトデが出る確率が下がる

en: blow up every fish of its kind in a row or column
pt-BR: explode todos os peixes da mesma espécie numa linha ou coluna
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines). "its kind" is the kind of fish under the cursor: every fish of that kind in the row or column it is pointed along blows up.
fr: fait exploser tous les poissons de son espèce dans une rangée ou une colonne
de: sprengt alle Fische seiner Art in einer Reihe oder Spalte
pl: wysadź wszystkie ryby tego gatunku w rzędzie lub kolumnie
es: vuela cada pez de su tipo en una fila o columna
ru: взорвать всех рыб этого вида в ряду или столбце
tr: bir satır ya da sütundaki kendi türünden her balığı havaya uçur
ja: 行か列の中で、同じ種類の魚をすべてふっとばす
zh-CN: 炸掉一行或一列中所有同种的鱼
ko: 가로줄이나 세로줄에서 같은 종류 물고기를 전부 날려 버려요

en: combos need 4 fish. a swap that makes 3 does not risk the multiplier
pt-BR: combos precisam de 4 peixes. uma troca que junta 3 não arrisca o multiplicador
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines). With this card a group needs 4 fish to pop; a swap that lines up only 3 pops nothing, but it does not count as a miss, so the multiplier is safe.
fr: les combos demandent 4 poissons. un échange qui en réunit 3 ne risque pas le multiplicateur
de: Kombos brauchen 4 Fische. ein Tausch, der 3 zusammenbringt, riskiert den Multiplikator nicht
pl: kombo wymaga 4 ryb. zamiana, która łączy 3, nie ryzykuje mnożnika
es: los combos necesitan 4 peces. un cambio que hace 3 no arriesga el multiplicador
ru: для комбо нужно 4 рыбы. обмен на 3 не рискует множителем
tr: kombolar 4 balık ister. 3 yapan takas çarpanı riske atmaz
ja: コンボに4匹必要。3匹そろう入れ替えでは倍率は危うくならない
zh-CN: 一组需要4条鱼。凑成3条的交换不会危及倍率
ko: 콤보에 물고기 4마리가 필요해요. 3마리를 맞춘 바꾸기는 배수를 걸지 않아요

notes: A card name on the upgrade screen, lower case. Short: it is fitted to a 124 pixel card title.

pt-BR: O coral cresce a cada anoitecer
notes: A card description, wrapped on the card (about 124 pixels wide, a few lines). "Moonfall" is when night falls in the game: the moon is full and the board goes dark. With this card, the coral on the board spreads each time that happens.
fr: Le corail pousse à chaque tombée de la nuit
es: El coral crece en cada anochecer
ja: 月が出るたびにサンゴが育つ
zh-CN: 每次入夜珊瑚都会生长

en: It can't just GIVE this away. Ask the old angler anything, or keep its light.
pt-BR: Ele não pode simplesmente DAR isso. Pergunte qualquer coisa ao velho peixe-pescador, ou guarde a luz.
notes: The card 'bright idea'. The anglerfish answers one free question at every upgrade screen; this card buys a real one, rumors included. GIVE is in capitals for emphasis because the text has no italics. Descriptions wrap at about 124 px.
fr: Elle ne peut pas tout DONNER. Demande ce que tu veux à la vieille baudroie, ou garde sa lumière.
de: Das kann er nicht einfach so HERGEBEN. Frag den alten Anglerfisch alles, oder behalte sein Licht.
pl: Tego nie może tak po prostu ROZDAĆ. Zapytaj starą żabnicę o wszystko albo zachowaj jej światło.
es: Esto no lo puede REGALAR. Pregúntale al viejo pez linterna lo que sea, o guarda su luz.
ru: Она не может просто так это ОТДАТЬ. Спроси старую удильщицу о чём угодно или оставь её свет.
tr: Bunu öylece VEREMEZ. Yaşlı fener balığına her şeyi sor, ya da ışığını sakla.
ja: タダで「あげる」わけにはいかない。年老いたアンコウに何でも聞くか、明かりを持っておこう。
zh-CN: 这可不能白送。问老安康鱼什么都行，或者留着它的灯。
ko: 이걸 그냥 공짜로 '줄' 순 없지. 늙은 초롱아귀한테 뭐든 묻거나, 불빛을 챙겨 둬.

notes: Button hints along the bottom of the upgrade screen. The last one asks the anglerfish a question. Keep {dir}, {confirm} and {info}.

en: The light is out. Nobody is down there now. This card does nothing.
pt-BR: A luz se apagou. Não há ninguém lá embaixo agora. Esta carta não faz nada.
notes: The card 'bright idea' after Ava, the anglerfish who answered questions, has left the game for good. The card is still dealt, but taking it does nothing, and this must say so plainly. Flat and a little sad. Descriptions wrap at about 124 px.
